# NinjaTMS.com

> NinjaTMS.com is a carrier Transportation Management System for truckload freight companies. It's integrated with Samsara, Motive, HOS24/7, and Geotab ELDs, WEX fuel cards (EFS/FleetOne), Motive fuel cards, and works with QuickBooks Online.

NinjaTMS automates carrier and dispatch workflows, consolidating load planning, dispatch, tracking, billing, and reporting into a single platform. Designed for both small fleets and enterprise carriers, it accelerates turn-times and reduces manual data entry.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ninjatms.com/): Overview of system, services, company focus.
- [About NinjaTMS](https://ninjatms.com/about/): Company background, mission, and team.
- [Integrations](https://ninjatms.com/integrations/): ELD, fuel card, and accounting integrations supported by NinjaTMS.
- [Signup](https://ninjatms.com/app/register.php): Registration form and trial activation.
- [Login](https://ninjatms.com/app/login.php): Secure access point for existing users.

## Solutions

- [Carrier TMS](https://ninjatms.com/tms-for-carriers/): TMS purpose-built for truckload carriers.
- [Trucking Management Software](https://ninjatms.com/trucking-management-software/): End-to-end trucking management platform.
- [Fleet Management Software](https://ninjatms.com/fleet-management-software/): Fleet management for small businesses.
- [Truck Scheduling Software](https://ninjatms.com/truck-scheduling-software/): Plan and assign loads to drivers and equipment.
- [AI Rate Confirmation Reader](https://ninjatms.com/ai-rate-confirmation/): Automatically parses rate confirmations into loads.
- [Trucking Dispatch Software](https://ninjatms.com/dispatch/): Dispatcher workflow, driver assignment, and communications.
- [Real-Time Truck Tracking](https://ninjatms.com/tracking/): Live truck and load location via ELD integrations.
- [Trucking Invoicing](https://ninjatms.com/invoicing/): Customer invoicing and accounts receivable.
- [Driver Pay & Settlements](https://ninjatms.com/driver-pay/): Driver settlements, pay rules, and payroll exports.
- [Motive TMS](https://ninjatms.com/motive-tms/): TMS for fleets running Motive ELDs.
- [Samsara TMS](https://ninjatms.com/samsara-tms/): TMS for fleets running Samsara ELDs.
- [Geotab TMS](https://ninjatms.com/geotab-tms/): TMS for fleets running Geotab.
- [HOS247 TMS](https://ninjatms.com/hos247-tms/): TMS for fleets running HOS247 ELDs.

## Who We Help

- [Owner-Operators](https://ninjatms.com/for-owner-operators/): TMS pricing and features for single-truck operators.
- [Small Fleets](https://ninjatms.com/for-small-fleets/): TMS for fleets of 2–25 trucks.
- [Flatbed Carriers](https://ninjatms.com/for-flatbed-carriers/): Flatbed-specific workflows and load handling.
- [Dispatch Companies](https://ninjatms.com/for-dispatch-companies/): TMS for third-party dispatch agencies.

## Optional

- [Loadboard Ninja](https://loadboard.ninjatms.com/): NinjaTMS's Chrome extension that augments carrier loadboards like DAT and Truckstop so dispatchers get all the information they need about a load in one click. The extension will also take notes, automatically send emails, and calculate estimated fuel expense.
- [Asteroids](https://ninjatms.com/asteroids): Easter egg 404 page featuring a fully functional Asteroids game and leaderboard.
